parameters.emailMessage/Subject: EVRi: Zebra and Non-Zebra Offline Devices
parameters.emailMessage/Body:
Hello,

Please find the report of offline devices attached.

Evri team, please follow up with the site managers on the devices offline for 15 days.
Devices offline for more than 30 days will be moved to LOST folder and locked if they come online.
Devices offline for more than 60 days will be deleted from SOTI. Zebra Service Desk please deactivate SIM cards for these devices.
ZEBRA DEVICES
@{outputs('Compose_3')}

NON-ZEBRA DEVICES
@{outputs('NonZebraCompose3')}
If there are any issues with this report, please contact your Zebra Service Manager (elena.brusentsova@zebra.com).

Warm regards

Zebra DMS Support
